decision_basis: Two independent Docker canonical-build cycles produced the same zte_tpd.ko SHA-256.
Candidate and stock AArch64 assembly have identical 46 instructions, 184-byte symbol size and resolved relocations.
Candidate and stock KCFI type IDs are identical: 0xe5c47d60.
Strict Joern gate passed with zero parse problems and one-to-one source/Ghidra identity coverage.
ASan/UBSan host harness passed 10/10 cases in both cycles and directly exercised tpd_zlog_init through test_layout_and_init.
